title: Green synthesized ZnO nanocatalysts for rapid and effective visible-light degradation of industrial dyes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2671-2684
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08475J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Toton Sarkar, Ashis Bhattacharjee
Green-synthesized ZnO catalyst degrades ∼99% of dyes in 90 min under visible light. Efficiency varies with crystallite size, pH, temperature, and catalyst dose. Catalyst retains activity over 5 cycles, showing strong stability.
